items.title: Playing Music in a Community Trio
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows three seated adults playing an acoustic guitar, hand drum and recorder.
items.description: The guitarist turns toward a smiling cap-wearing drummer while the bespectacled recorder player faces inward from the opposite side. Separate wooden chairs and clear instrument shapes keep the small ensemble easy to follow.

items.title: Making a Family Keepsake Frame
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows an older man and a braided child arranging portrait shapes in a wooden keepsake frame.
items.description: The open frame lies across their table beside loose card pieces, glue and a large paper flower. The man wears a plain garrison cap and plaid shirt while the child leans toward the right-hand portrait opening.
